title: Legal privilege in the era of Generative AI
description: The rise of Generative Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) has fundamentally altered how individuals seek information, including legal guidance. Millions of users across the globe now routinely consult AI chatbots such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT or Anthropic’s Claude, for assistance on issues ranging from employment disputes and commercial transactions to criminal defence strategies.The intuitive and conversational interface of these tools creates a deceptive sense of confidentiality.
